j3q_JRPY6Vs.description: Welcome to something new! if you are wondering where all the videos have gone, I explain it in this video but I did make another video talking about it but I didn't put it on youtube so maybe I should upload that here too! i don't know where this is going or what it will turn into but stay turned and you and us will find out together!

nEpZHuVY480.description:
a house tour of the top villas house we stayed in during the 2 weeks in Orlando - if you would like to book this house for your own family or friends then go here http://www.thetopvillas.com/sj 
We are sad to be leaving Orlando as this has been the best trip! i wanted to do something fun for my birthday and this was just that, something for everyone!

Next time we come back we can try and finish off seeing all the parts of Disney that we missed and also if the kids are that bit older and have finally seen or read all the Harry potter books/films we can visit universal, we didn't go this time because Eduardo and Emilia have only seen 2 of the movies so i didn't think there would be enough interest yet but lets see how the years goes!

ro7RGZG_JBQ.description:
As some of you know, Anna is a US citizen so it has always been an open door for us if we ever wanted to move there. A few months before we moved to the UK we had gone as far as hiring a company to ship the dogs over and started looking for a house when i ended up making contacts in London and we decided to explore this route instead but now all these years later its still something that we both are open too. 

I think we would look at living in both countries as an option, so school term in the UK so they wouldn't have to lose their friends but all other times in the US.. it sounds like a crazy plan but the cost of living in the US is dramatically less then where we live in the UK, house prices are much better too plus if we moved near any of the Disney parks we could go there all the time!

it's just a thought that might become something more or might not.. life is life that! but i wanted to put it out there into the world as its what we are thinking about right now.

yzk8TO6xNnc.description:
This was the most insane jam packed day ever!! we were at the park before it even opened to try and get to do the Avatar experience, then off to Hollywood studios to a frozen show, followed by the tower of terror which both Emilia and Eduardo went on!!! if you haven't been on it.. its basically an elevator that goes all the way to the top and then breaks and just falls... and then if that wasn't enough we went over to StarWars world and did the Millennium Falcon experience which was just incredible and ended the night with a stage and fireworks show at Disney!! what a last day it was!! 

i hope you have enjoyed this Disney series! i didn't plan on making so many videos but everyday was just so magical so i wanted to film it all and share it with you!!

XGZ0RaxsMiU.description:
the video you have all been waiting for and what we were so excited to do! this isn't a cheap activity by any means but we just had to do it!! the kids loved every minute of the make over! and some people were asking when we put this on Instagram why Eduardo wasn't a princess? (Disney do allow this for boys) we did offer him a princess package but he said he wanted to be a prince! 

Ever since Andrea came into the mix Eduardo has been influenced and started to show more interest in more "boyish" things! he still loves a good barbie and being his fabulous self but he is changing slightly, growing up, evolving and in our family all the kids are free to be whoever they want and at any point can change their minds too, i believe identity is fluid and love is love

ObfP4lefNIw.description:
It started out like any other day.. well any other day at Disney that involves the most amazing day and ends with an hot air balloon ride over Disney!! i've seen some people in the comments asking how we manage the rides with the kids, this is main reason we brought someone with us to help because if we didn't we wouldn't be able to split up all the time or been able to go on half the rides we did! so there was 3 adults and 4 kids, 1 to film/drive/make jokes (me) 1 to manage older kids (Anna) and 1 to manage younger kids (friend) its didn't always go in that order but you get the idea! 


hope you are enjoying these Disney videos!

fnr-n6TOdws.description:
Little 2 year old Alessia went on her first roller coaster at Disney World! her reaction was surprising!! do you remember how old you were when you went on your first? It's always a magical day at magic kingdom and we got to meet Snow White and TinkerBell, went on the tea cups and almost broke Jonathan but had another amazing day at Disney World! 

this is turning out to be the best trip ever! i love how the different ages of the kids enjoy different aspects so we end up doing such a good mix

Vm9CXBp7FEU.description:
Alessia's big day finally came round!! the day she was to meet her heroes Anna and Elsa from Frozen!! it only took a couple of hours of waiting and a hand full of melt downs but we got there in the end! 

Everyday has been so jam packed it going to feel so strange when we get home and not have to walk 20k steps everyday around a park will millions of people and wait in line for half the day!! haha all part of the Disney experience

Pu91nM1OSzI.description: Who remembers when we lost the kids at this mall all those years ago!! ha well we decided to brave it again all for a cheese cake! it was raining today so we thought it was the perfect day to head off to a mall and hit up a cheese cake factory!

BDyKAgGGFJk.description:
it happened!! i had my big birthday at Disney world and what a surprise i ended up in a Disney movie!! Alessia got a role too!! everyday is so magical here!! and i love seeing Alessia experience all the things the older too did! next time it will be Andrea's big moment but im not sure meeting princesses is in his goal book! ha

if you would like to book the house we are staying at you can, its with TopVilla's and use this link https://www.thetopvillas.com/sj

zEBtIvhy9BU.description:
Alessia finally got to live out the videos she has been watching for the last few years!! her reactions to meeting the princesses were so amazing, not sure Andrea had any idea what was going on and Emilia and Eduardo were experiencing it much older now and probably better able to understand it all!

and this was only day 1!! 

also thank you all for the birthday messages on all the social platforms! the next video will be how i spent my 40th birthday at Disney world magic kingdom!

if you would like to book the house we are staying at you can, its with TopVilla's and use this link https://www.thetopvillas.com/sj

DLiYmmjJ_Xk.description:
we took 4 kids on a 10 hour flight to Orlando !! I assumed Emilia and Eduardo would be fine because can watch the screens but are biggest concern was the little ones Andrea and Alessia who dont really watch screens for that long!! it was a challenge but we got there in the end and now we are in Orlando and ready for our Disney adventure! 

how cool was that tram clip of all 4 of the kids sitting up front! i actually had to miss the first tram because there was already people sitting up there in order to make that clip but i really wanted to re-create that so i think it was worth being a little later!

if you would like to book the house we are staying at you can, its with TopVilla's and use this link https://www.thetopvillas.com/sj

tSFr1psC328.description:
By the time you are watching this we will probably already be in Orlando, Florida!! it's been a few years since we travelled over to the US so it we are really excited to experience US life again and maybe we will even meet some of you while we are out there!! 

Disney is also going to be a blast being that its Alessia and Andrea's first time there and Emilia and Eduardo haven't been there since they are so small!! 

so get ready for a few weeks of epic videos!!

JXuJqd-Gfis.description:
alot of people guessed in the last video but its official!! we are going to Disney World, and Orlando in general as we are not staying at Disney. I never thought this was how i was going to spend my 40th birthday but my kids are the best thing about me so this makes sense to me! ha 

get ready for some amazing vlogs over the next weeks! 

This will be Alessia's and Andrea's first time at Disney too!! 

*this is NOT a paid or gifted partnership with Disney, i saw some tweets and comments suggesting it was, Anna paid for it all and organised it all.. if this was a partnership i would have known about it too as i do all the boring business stuff!

bh_6FqKQh5g.description: Well i didn't see that coming! but aww that was nice of Anna to say what she said and o boy!! i am excited for where we are going! when i think about a milestone like my 40th and i think who would i want to celebrate that with and i'm pretty sure if you have been watching these videos for a while now you would know the answer! so where we are going will be a treat for the whole family and also the other very important people in my life who have been with my for the last 10 years! im talking about you of course!! get ready for some amazing videos!!1

fNtr7PvExhg.description: So we brought the whole gang out to bills for brunch and i never really thought about this before but the kids had never tried pudding before! i only like white pudding and i always try not to think about what it actually is but we decided to see if the kids would like it!! guess what Alessia thought! ha

meJVCqsgPsI.description: You may remember back at Christmas time last year the kids thought they saw Santa up the chimney and tried to pull his sack down which resulted in all the soot coming down and ruining the new white carpet in the living room!! well we finally had it with that and decided to hire a rug doctor and see if we can give the living room a makeover!! the results were amazing!!

SOL9cQT5oOw.description:
We were invited to the National TV awards so we called in the full team and brought you along the way! from our stylist Ray bringing over samples for Anna to choose to hair, make up and chasing the kids around the house after they stole my cream egg! if you want to see what we got up to at the awards show check out my instagram video https://www.instagram.com/p/B75-X_7gGQZ/

Hair by @alexsmithhair
Makeup by @nadiaharpermua

8rSYY9Du1Zo.description: Anna got her first ever spray tan!! she has always just used creams herself but as seen as Jonathan is always getting it done and we have that event coming up she decided to try it! and Alessia thought she could help too! we all got hair cuts too and Alessia got to go to the party she has been talking about for the last few weeks!

bfPdWB5Y0LI.description:
We are heading to the National TV awards next week and Nouveau lashes got in touch and asked Anna would she like to try (gifted) an eyelash lift! Jonathan did a cooking segment involving pineapples and sausages and Emilia and Alessia had a sing along.. we also said goodbye to the old management office. 

What do you think about the idea of getting an electric car for the school runs? any suggestions on a 4 seater little EV city car?

have a good weekend and we will see you on Monday!

af4Yxh_rzVI.description: Anna decided to try on her old clothes, her post pregnancy and pre pregnancy clothes to see how that would fit her now! Alessia is excited to go to a party in her pretty dress and Jonathan explains what he might in that last video as i think some people got it wrong! thanks for watching! please leave a comment and like the video as that helps the channel a lot!

AdKIMBoqlPo.description: We left the kids alone and they destroyed the house!! specifically the playroom! has this ever happened to you? we did a cool before and after and then went out for food!

Short History of SACCONEJOLYs

In 2008 Anna was uploading beauty videos to youtube on her own channel and Jonathan was helping her behind the scenes.

In late 2009 Jonathan set up this channel because he wanted to do his own youtube videos. What started out as a week experiment to film his life everyday for 7 days in a row has now become SACCONEJOLYS

this channel was formally known as LeFloofTV but was later changed to SACCONEJOLYs

When Jonathan Joly married Anna Saccone they both decided that instead of Anna dropping her family name they would both take each others name and join them together.

They choose to use SACCONEJOLY rather then JOLYSACCONE simply because it sounded better.

Jonathan and Anna Saccone Joly have four children, Emilia Saccone Joly, Eduardo Saccone Joly, Alessia Saccone Joly and Andrea Saccone Joly they also have six maltese dogs, Albi, Sina, Theo, Bianca, Nivea and Nuvola.

They moved from Ireland to the UK in 2014.

********************************

SpiiXLoE7RU.description:
Please Donate if you can https://giantpledge.com/harrysgiantpledge
I cried the whole time making this video so i imagine you are going though the same thing, i just felt like i had to do something even though nothing was going to make this better! maybe if we let Harry do some good in this world for the short time he is here, it might bring meaning to his life.

On 29 April 2019 five-year-old Harry Shaw was given 1 week to live after a 9 month battle against Ewing’s Sarcoma; a rare bone cancer. Despite this terminal diagnosis he's still fighting to stay alive.

Harry’s parents, Charlotte and James, set up Harry’s Giant Pledge working with giantpledge.com and the Royal Marsden Cancer Charity. Their aim is to raise money for research into Ewing’s Sarcoma and other childhood cancers to ensure children like Harry have a better chance of surviving. 

Harry was diagnosed with cancer on 2 August 2018 when a routine scan on a small lump showed a tumour the size of a large baked potato inside Harry’s right chest. Harry was 4.

In the space of a few minutes on that hot sunny afternoon the Shaw Family's life was changed forever.

When Jonathan Joly married Anna Saccone they both decided that instead of Anna dropping her family name they would both take each others name and join them together.

Jonathan and Anna Saccone Joly have three children, Emilia Saccone Joly, Eduardo Saccone Joly and Alessia Saccone Joly. they also have six maltese dogs, Albi, Sina, Theo, Bianca, Nivea and Nuvola.

T11l0SAenCY.description:
PAWS is a work in progress, we started out in Feb 1997 with the intention to rehome unwanted dogs from their current homes. However, we soon realised the huge amount of abuse, neglect and abandonment of dogs throughout the County and we started to give them shelter and veterinary care... News spread fast and soon we were dealing with cases from Cork and Kerry to Sligo and Donegal... Since that time PAWS, has rescued, vaccinated, neutered and rehomed thousands of dogs and as 70% of these were adults, our neutering programme has prevented millions of unwanted puppies being born and consequently dumped in ditches, dustbins and dog pounds.
Sometimes we feel like 'giving up and giving in' but then somebody says a kind word or calls to visit, with a happy, healthy adored pet, which when it originally came in to our care was a quivering, ravenous, petrified mess. Days like those give you the strength to carry on that extra mile.

As you may know, we at PAWS depend totally on the public to help us to keep our doors open to abandoned and abused animals. The National Lottery have thus far ignored pleas from Animal Welfare groups to grant aid our work and the Dept of Agriculture very kindly give a small grant each year to rescue centers Sadly, however, this covers only a minute portion of the running costs, which ran to over 300 thousand euro last year. The rest is made up from flag days, fundraisers and donations. We, at PAWS now find ourselves under serious pressure. Our biggest expense being veterinary fees... we never seem to reduce the debt because of the vast volume of dogs coming through our doors, for a rescue our size to handle an average of ten dogs a week for vaccination, worming, neutering and micro chipping is extremely difficult financially.
